    7-Star Dragapult Tera Raid Event: Best Counters and Rewards

    Add to Watchlist
    Pokemon Scarlet and Violet (SV) Walkthrough Team
    Last updated on: November 20, 2026 04:28 AM

    ◓ 7★ Dragapult Tera Raid Rerun (11/20~11/26)!
    ☆ Tier List | Doubles Tier List | Movesets | Rental Teams

    Trainers can catch a Dragon Tera Type Dragapult with the Mightiest Mark during the 7-Star Dragapult Tera Raid Event rerunning from November 20 ~ 26 2026 in Pokemon Scarlet and Violet (SV). Learn the start and end date of this Tera Raid Event, the best counters to use and how to beat Dragapult, all rewards you can get, and how to join.

    7-Star Dragapult Tera Raid Event Duration

    Raid Event Duration
    (Until November 26, 2026 23:59 UTC)

    Dragapult Tera Raid Event Rerun is Live!

    Schedule Recent Rerun Date:
    Start Date: 2026/11/20 00:00 UTC
    End Date: 2026/11/26 23:59 UTC
    Initial Release:
    Round 1
    Start Date: 2025/12/05 00:00 UTC
    End Date: 2025/12/07 23:59 UTC
    Round 2
    Start Date: 2025/12/12 00:00 UTC
    End Date: 2025/12/14 23:59 UTC
    Rewards 7-Star Dragapult
    Defeat "Dragapult the Unrivaled" in a Black Crystal Tera Raid during the event and you'll get a Dragon Tera Type Dragapult with the Mightiest Mark.
    Treasures and Battle Items
    Obtain various items which you can use to build battle-ready Pokemon or sell in stores for money.
    Unlock Requirements Unlock 6-Star Tera Raid Battles to Participate
    To do this, you'll need to complete the Academy Ace Tournament, then do 8-10 4-Star or 5-Star Raids until you get a call from Jacq.

    The Rerun of the special 7-star Tera Raid Event featuring Dragapult with the Ghost Tera Type is currently underway! The event runs from November 20, 2026 (00:00 UTC) up until November 26, 2026 (11:59 UTC) as a set with the Pseudo-Legendary Pokemon Tera Raid Events.

    Dragapult with the Mightiest Mark, the featured Pokemon for this event, could only be caught once. However, you can still participate in this event even after you've caught Dragapult if you want to get more of its rewards.

    Tera Raid Event Codes Board

    You Can't Catch Dragapult if You've Participated in the First Run

    If you caught the Mighty Dragapult from its initial 2025 run, you won't be able to catch one during this event series.

    Tera Raid Event Location

    Just like previous 7-Star Tera Raid events, the 7-Star Dragapult Raid Dens would only spawn in Paldea. If you haven't purchased The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero DLC, no need to worry as the Raid Den cannot appear in Kitakami or the Terarium. You also don't need to do the Mochi Mayhem Epilogue in order to start this raid.

    Best Counter for 7-Star Dragapult Raid: Avalugg!

    How to Join 7-Star Dragapult Raid Event

    Unlock 6-Star Tera Raids to Participate

    Dragapult normally cannot be found in Paldea, making the 7-Star Event Dragapult quite the catch, but you have to fight it in a Black Crystal Tera Raid.

    These raids are tough, so trainers will have to prepare in advance. It's also recommended to complete the post-game before you participate. Players who are in earlier points of the game can still join via Link Code, but it is highly discouraged since these 7-Star raids will be extremely difficult.

    How to Unlock 6-Star Raids and List of Pokemon

    Black Tera Raids vs. Normal Tera Raids

    Remember that Black Tera Raid symbols on the map do not come in any other color except black. Meanwhile, normal Tera Raid symbols are colored according to the Tera Type of the Pokemon in them.

    When you're looking for the Tera Raid with the 7-Star Dragapult, keep your eyes peeled for a Black Tera Raid symbol on the map with the Dragon-type icon.

    Black Crystal Tera Raid Battles

    Join Online Event Tera Raids


    You are able to join Event Raid Dens online. When the event is live, you can use our Tera Raid Board to coordinate a team to take it down!

    Tera Raid Codes Board

    How to Join Online Tera Raid Events

    Nintendo Online Needed to Play with Others

    To participate in the event with other players, you must have a paid Nintendo Switch Online membership, which is bought separately from the game.

    Multiplayer Modes: All New Co-Op Adventure and Connectivity Options

    Update Poke Portal News

    Trainers must also make sure they have the latest version of Poke Portal News in their game. This should automatically download if your Switch is connected to the Internet.

    How to Check Poke Portal News

    1
    Press the X Button and select "Poke Portal." Make sure your Switch is connected to the internet.
    2
    Select "Mystery Gift."
    3
    Select "Check Poke Portal News."
